No—not for every sensor across the full period. NASA FIRMS reported **zero thermal detections intersecting the property** from October 13 to November 12, 2026, but VIIRS S-NPP data were unavailable from November 2 to November 6.

MODIS, VIIRS NOAA-20 and VIIRS NOAA-21 had coverage for the full period and reported no detections. This does not prove that no fire occurred; small, short-lived, cool or cloud-obscured fires can be missed.
